svg.aria-label: Install claude-blog in Claude Code with two commands: add the marketplace and install the plugin. The newsstand opens, a claude-blog issue drops into the press, the inventory fills with 32 skills, 5 agents take the shelf, and /blog write starts level 1: research for your first blog post.
